content: Aulataʼala Adhawu Kuasa i Musa to Apewau Muuzizati

Kasiimpo Musa alawani i KAWASANA OPU, "Maka, tuaapa ande manga miana Israel inda aunda aparacaea tee inda afaduliakea manga pogauku? Opea tabeana ipewauku ande manga incia apogau KAWASANA OPU inda apatiumbaaka karona i iaku?"
KAWASANA OPU aabha i Musa, "Opea i limamu itu?" Musa alawani, "Katuko."
Firimanina KAWASANA OPU, "Tudhaakea i tana." Musa atudhaakamea i tana, kasiimpo katuko sumai amembalimo ulo sabutuna Musa apalai pekaridho.
KAWASANA OPU afirimani i Musa, "Paulumea limamu tee rakoa lencina." Musa apaulumea limana, arakomea, kasiimpo ulo sumai amembalimo katuko pendua i limana.

Firimanina KAWASANA OPU, "Pewaumo mboo sumai mamudhaakana manga miana Israel aparacaea ande Iaku, KAWASANA OPU, Aulataʼalana manga opuopuana, Aulataʼalana Ibrahim, Ishak tee Yakub, padhamo apatiumbaaka karona i ingkoo."
KAWASANA OPU afirimanimo uka i Musa, "Papesuamea o limamu i nuncana bhajumu." Musa aose, tee wakutuuna incia apalimba limana, limana sumai amaputimo mpuu roonamo akangkanaia panyaki kuli dhaa.
Kasiimpo KAWASANA OPU afirimani, "Papesuaia limamu pendua i nuncana bhajumu." Musa apewau mboo sumai, tee wakutuuna apalimbaia uka, limana sumai auntomo mboomo bhaa-bhaana.

Firimanina KAWASANA OPU, "Ande manga incia inda aparacaeako atawa inda ayaakini sapadhana akamata giu inda momentela tee katukomu, sumaimo manga incia bheaparacaea giu inda momentela sii bheupewaua tee limamu.

Maka ande manga incia indapo uka aparacaeako moomini padhamo akamata rua-rua angua giu inda momentela sii, tee manga incia inda afaduliakea manga pogaumu, alamo saidhe o uwe minaaka i Umala Nil tee ulalimea i tana. Kasiimpo uwe sumai bheabhalii amembali raa."

Maka o Musa apogau i KAWASANA OPU, "E, Kawasana Opu, iaku mencuana mia momakidhana mopogau, malape i piamo itu atawa sii-sii. Moomini sapadhana Ingkoo upogau tee iaku, kupogau amanoe roonamo amatamo dhelaku tee inda kumakidha kupogau."

KAWASANA OPU afirimani i incia, "Incema buaka modhawuna muncu to maanusia? Incema buaka mopamembalina incia abhea atawa amabhongo? Incema mopamembalina incia apokamata atawa amawilo? Iaku, KAWASANA OPU, mopewauna bhari-bharia sumai!
Jadi, lingkamo. Iaku bhekutulungiko upogau tee uadhariaka opea tabeana bheubhoasaka."
Maka Musa alawani, "Iaku kuemani mpuu, bholimo ulamboko iaku, e Kawasana Opu, tumpumo mia mosagaanana."

Sumaimo KAWASANA OPU aʼamara i Musa tee apogau, "Mencuana ingkoo buaka mokowitinaina mokosarona Harun? Iaku kumataua incia amakidha apogau. Satotuuna, incia i nuncana lingkaana tangasaana arope iwe sii, tee incia bheasanaa apokawa tee ingkoo.
Ingkoo tabeana upogau i incia tee upaumbaakea opea tabeana ipogauakana. Iaku bhekutulungi rua miakomiu tee kuadhariaka opea tabeana ipogauakamiu tee ipewaumiu.
Incia bheapogau to saromu i manga miana Mesir sumai. Mboomo Aulataʼala, ingkoo bheupaumbaakea opea tabeana ibhoasakana, tee incia bheamembali mopakawaakana pogaumu.
Bhawamea katuko sumai, tee upakea to upewau manga giu inda momentela tee katuko sumai.
Nabii Musa Ambuli i Mesir

Sapadhana sumai Musa ambulimo i bhanuana Yitro, ama maniana, tee apogau i incia, "Undakaakumo kumbuli i manga witinaiku i Mesir to kukamata manga incia ara dhaangiapo adhadhi." Yitro apogau i Musa, "Lingkamo tee usalaamati."
Wakutuuna Musa dhaangiapo i Tana Midian, KAWASANA OPU apogau i incia, "Mbulimo i Mesir. Bhari-bharia mia mohaejatina to apekamateko amatemo."
Kasiimpomo Musa akemba bhawinena tee manga anana umane, apakompaia manga i bhawona sambaa keledai kasiimpo ambuli i Tana Mesir. Incia uka abhawa katukona Aulataʼala.

KAWASANA OPU afirimani i Musa, "Iaku padhamo kudhawuko kuasa to upewau manga giu inda momentela. Jadi ande ingkoo umbuli i Mesir naile itu, pewaumea sagala giu inda muuzizati sumai i aroana Firaun. Maka Iaku bhekupekakaaia incana, mamudhaakana incia inda aundaakea miana lipu sumai alingka.
Pogauakamea i Firaun mboo sii, 'KAWASANA OPU aposamea, "Israel satotuuna o ana tumpeku,
tee kufirimani i ingkoo: Undaakea anaku sumai alingka mamudhaakana incia amembali asambahea i Iaku. Ande ingkoo umendeu, sumaimo Iaku bhekupekamate anamu, siitumo o ana tumpemu." ' "
I saangu tampa pokemaa i nuncana lingkaana sumai, KAWASANA OPU aumbati Musa
ahaejati to apekamatea.
Maka, Zipora bhawinena, aalamo saangu bhatu matadha to atandaki anana, kasiimpo apadhingkuakea o kuli sumai i aena Musa. Pogauna Zipora, "Ingkoo umaneku itandaiku tee raa."
(Zipora apogauaka giu incia sumai roonamo incia padhamo atandaki ana umanena.) Sabutuna KAWASANA OPU inda asidha apekamate Musa.
KAWASANA OPU afirimanimo i Harun, "Lingkamo i tana matuu upokawa tee Musa." Sumaimo, Harun alingkamo, kasiimpo apokawa tee andina i gununa Aulataʼala, tee aikia.
Musa apetulatulaakea i Harun bhari-bharia firimanina KAWASANA OPU itumpuakana i incia to apakawaakea, tee uka bhari-bharia giu inda momentela iparintaakana i incia to apewaua.
Kasiimpomo Musa tee Harun alingka i Mesir tee aromusaka bhari-bharia manga mancuanana Israel.
Harun apakawaaka i manga incia bhari-bharia ifirimaniakana KAWASANA OPU i Musa, tee Musa akarajaaia bhari-bharia giu inda momentela i aroana manga mia sumai.
Sumaimo aparacaeamo manga incia, tee wakutuuna arangoa ande KAWASANA OPU padhamo amaheruakea miana Israel tee akamatea bhari-bharia kanarakaana manga, manga incia asuju asomba.

footnotes.text: katukona Aulataʼala: Katuko sumai adhawua kuasa minaaka i Aulataʼala to apewau manga giu inda momentela.
ana tumpeku: Ibaratina miana Israel adhawua Aulataʼala kauncuramaka momalanga i tanga-tangana bhari-bharia lipu i dunia sii.
Musa: I nuncana kaburina Ibrani, soomo dhaangia "aumbatia", jadi inda atomataua opea maʼanana Musa atawa ana tumpena Musa.

umaneku itandaiku tee raa: Dhaangia manga ahalii Kitabi Momangkilo mofikirina pogauna sumai roonamo Musa satotuuna umanena, maka dhaangia uka manga ahalii mofikirina pogauna sumai roonamo Musa padhamo atoampuni minaaka i dosana, aipomo dosana wakutuuna incia apekamate miana Mesir.
